answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort.. It is effective because voting power is weighted by verifiable work over time, so a fresh flood of accounts cannot manufacture a decisive vote. Consider a wharf as the anchor of the cost.
